_comment: Proof-of-identity list for enable-ngrok.ps1. These are the three FISH games that must appear in /api/v1/public/games. Kept in a UTF-8 JSON data file ON PURPOSE: enable-ngrok.ps1 must stay pure ASCII, because Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads .ps1 files as ANSI (GBK on this machine) unless a BOM is present, and a Chinese literal inside the script becomes a PARSE ERROR (verified 2026-10-04). Read here with an explicit UTF-8 reader instead. 'codes' is the decisive check: it comes from the game table, so it cannot be spoofed by an ngrok browser-warning page (which is plain text and never passes the JSON/field assertions in the first place).
